questions.q: Which publisher released The Mask comics?
questions.why: Dark Horse Comics published The Mask, with Mike Richardson behind the concept.

questions.q: Which actor starred as The Mask in the 1994 film?
questions.why: Jim Carrey played Stanley Ipkiss in the 1994 film directed by Chuck Russell.

questions.q: What colour does the Mask make its wearer's head?
questions.why: The mask's wearer gets a green head with a toothy grin and reality-bending powers.

questions.q: Which actress made her screen debut as Tina Carlyle in the 1994 film?
questions.why: The 1994 film marked Cameron Diaz's screen debut, as Tina Carlyle.

questions.q: Who conceived The Mask concept at the publisher?
questions.why: Mike Richardson of the publisher came up with the idea of the Mask.

questions.q: Which Norse god is the Mask's creator in Son of the Mask?
questions.why: Alan Cumming took the role of Loki, the mask's maker, in 2005's Son of the Mask.

questions.q: Who directed the 1994 film The Mask?
questions.why: Chuck Russell directed the 1994 film, which starred its comedy lead.

questions.q: Who designed the definitive look of The Mask comics?
questions.why: Chris Warner designed the definitive look of the Mask, while John Arcudi wrote and Doug Mahnke drew.

questions.q: The Big Head Mask first appeared in a 1989 anthology named what?
questions.why: The Big Head version debuted in Mayhem #1 in May 1989.

questions.q: Who voices Stanley Ipkiss in the 1995 animated series?
questions.why: The Mask: Animated Series ran from 1995 to 1997 with Rob Paulsen as Stanley Ipkiss.
